notes.title: JulFlux has released a new game!
notes.content:
A few months after the release of Chess'Extra, I am proud to announce the release of Spiky, a puzzle platform game mixing 2D and 3D :

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493660/Spiky/]Spiky[/url]

I would also like to take the time to thank all those who have played Chess'Extra, now over 9000, and all the new players to come.
Special thanks to all those who participated financially through the DLCs!

notes.title: New game mode!
notes.content:
New game mode "Random Positions" available !

Basic chess now available ! (Not compatible with the "Reinforcements" mode).

[u]Bug fixes[/u]:
-The game now ends in a draw if checkmate is impossible with the remaining pieces.
-If a piece is trapped, it can no longer checkmate the king.
-Fixed problem that brought a piece on a trap when the trap was not on its trajectory.
-If a piece is protecting the king against a queen, rook or bishop, it can now move freely between the threatening piece and the king.
-Sometimes the AI did not play its turn, this should not happen anymore.

notes.title: New game mode!
notes.content:
New game mode "Fog of war" available!

New option to show the opponent's last move.

Fivefold rule added, the game will automatically end in a draw if the same position on the board has occurred 5 times.

Russian translation added.

The prices of the customization menu are now lower.

You will now get money if you quit an online game and have captured pieces.

Added an indication if a king is in check.

The ballists on the castle will now send their animations to your opponent.

Some minor graphical bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update - New Game Mode
notes.content:
New "Reinforcements" mode which adds 4 pawns and proposes to change their starting position between 6 different positions.

Graphic changes and addition of ballists on the castles which will soon be fully usable.
